messages.subject: Data request
parts:
Hi all,

As part of a potential study comparing the results produced from the two survey methods (point counts & transect counts), we are wondering if anyone has, or knows of, datasets which:

- include point count and line transect surveys carried out in the same sites on the same species/taxonomic group
- had some level of measurement of the distance from the observer/line to the observation (so DISTANCE analysis is possible)
- can be from any habitat type globally

If anybody has any enquiries or knows of any such datasets and would be open to collaboration, please get in touch at colin.g...@research.atu.ie .

Thanks very much and apologies if this post is breaking any group rules.

Colin
